definition: Locations and times represented by labels used in a stated out-of-sample evaluation.

definition: Model covariates and predictions evaluated over a global coastal grid.
authorizes: applicability visualization, never global validation by itself

definition: Grouped out-of-fold predictions whose labels may guide selection.
authorizes: development comparison, not locked or independent claims

definition: A preregistered holdout opened once after candidate freeze.

definition: A reserved internal holdout whose labels remain inaccessible.
authorizes: no result claim before the one-time audit

definition: Labels acquired and kept sealed outside model development.
authorizes: independent evidence only after provenance and non-use are audited
